question: Should the generic channel-auth seam expose this public typed `ChannelLoginMethod` contract, and should this branch supersede the narrower live-tested implementation?
rationale: Both branches solve the same feature with different permanent plugin APIs and proof strengths; source inspection and tests cannot determine the intended public contract.

options.title: Adopt this typed API
options.body: Approve the reusable capability-advertised contract, obtain exact-head live validation, and make this the canonical branch.

options.title: Use the narrower PR
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85866 if phone-number login should remain a WhatsApp-specific adapter parameter.

options.title: Keep the type internal
options.body: Use typed core dispatch without exporting the method through the public Plugin SDK until another channel needs it.

recommendation.title: Adopt this typed API
recommendation.body: Approve the reusable capability-advertised contract, obtain exact-head live validation, and make this the canonical branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame shows this person introduced the generic channel login dispatch being extended, and earlier history connects them to WhatsApp login/session behavior.
